summary: Accumulate prior and incoming receipt quantities exactly once, rejecting duplicate-entry overage before writes.
Permit additional valid partial receipts while aggregate status remains PARTIALLY_RECEIVED.
Six real-service cases with actual errors, serializer and transition function cover partial, full, prior, duplicate and refusal paths.
limits: Repository and transaction adapters; inert Zod schema builders for module loading only, no schema parsing, SQL rollback or concurrent receipt protection tested.
Service assumes validated finite nonnegative quantities; current source reads receipt totals before transaction.
